name: The Tech Interactive
description: The Tech Interactive (formerly The Tech Museum) is a hands-on science and technology center in downtown San Jose. Featuring innovative exhibits on robotics, virtual reality, renewable energy, and more, it inspires the next generation of innovators.
fullDescription: The Tech Interactive (formerly The Tech Museum) is a hands-on science and technology center in downtown San Jose. Featuring innovative exhibits on robotics, virtual reality, renewable energy, and more, it inspires the next generation of innovators.
whatTheyOffer:
- Museums for All: $5 per person general admission for up to six people with a SNAP/EBT, BIC, or WIC card
- Add an educational IMAX film for $5 more per person with Museums for All
- Military and veterans: Free general admission (galleries only) year-round; up to five family members also free May through September (Blue Star Museums)
- Regular admission: $38 adults; $28 children 3-17, students, and seniors 65+ (includes one educational IMAX film)
howToGetIt: Show a valid SNAP/EBT, BIC, or WIC card with ID at the box office; this discount is redeemed in person, not online. The Tech is closed most Mondays, so check hours before you go.
address: 201 South Market Street, San Jose, CA 95113
keywords: The Tech Interactive, Tech Museum, San Jose, science museum, robotics, virtual reality, EBT $5, IMAX, Silicon Valley
